explication: This is a SillyTavern extension for structured, editable long-term roleplay memory. The principal workflow loads extension settings and chat-scoped sheets, lets users edit tables and templates, then generates or refreshes memory through configured API calls and can push rendered tables into chat. The README also describes prompt injection, custom display styles, template sharing/export, and stepwise tasks. Relationships below use excerpts, SOURCE INDEX references, or README statements; unsampled subsystems are represented conservatively.
